scenarios.name: degrees-of-freedom-01 Show indicators on a rectangle

scenario_steps.name: an active sketch with a rectangle and no red freedom arrows
the user open the empty-canvas context menu and choose Show All Degrees of Freedom
red arrows appear at the rectangle corners and side midpoints
the status remains Ready with 4 dimensions needed
the fixture sketch contains a rectangle and projected contours
red freedom arrows are visible and Ready reports 4 dimensions needed
the user reopen the context menu
it offers Hide All Degrees of Freedom
the user choose that command
the arrows disappear while the rectangle and projected contours remain visible
the status remains Ready with 4 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: degrees-of-freedom-03 Undo and redo the display operation

scenario_steps.name: an active sketch contains the required mixed geometry, visible constraint glyphs and no red freedom indicators
Ready reports 13 dimensions needed
the user choose Show All Degrees of Freedom from the canvas context menu
red translation and rotation indicators are visible
the user press Ctrl+Z
the red indicators disappear while geometry and constraint glyphs remain visible
the user press Ctrl+Y
the red indicators return
the status remains 13 dimensions needed

scenarios.name: degrees-of-freedom-04 Retain shown mode across same-session sketch reentry

scenario_steps.name: the mixed-geometry fixture sketch reports 13 dimensions needed
freedom indicators are shown
the user click Finish Sketch
the 3D Model ribbon appears and red freedom indicators are not visible in that view
the user right-click the sketch in the browser and choose Edit Sketch
the sketch returns in RIGHT view with red freedom indicators displayed
the status reports 13 dimensions needed
the user open the canvas context menu
Hide All Degrees of Freedom is available
the user choose it
the red indicators disappear and Ready still reports 13 dimensions needed
